scope.model: MiniCPM-V-4.6-Q4_K_M with existing F16 vision weights and unchanged Q4_K_M language path

W8A8_reference.weight_packing: one signed int8 byte per weight

W4A8_primary.weight_packing: two signed two's-complement nibbles per byte; lower nibble is lower K index; reserved -8 never emitted

quantization.weight_scale_granularity: one F32 scale per output channel m and K group g, fixed offline from original F16 weights
quantization.activation_scale_granularity: one F32 scale per input token n and K group g, computed dynamically from that F32 activation group
quantization.scale_rule: max(abs(finite_values))/scale_divisor; if all values are zero, scale=1 and all codes=0
quantization.nonfinite_rule: nonfinite source values invalidate this quantized call; explicit CPU fallback, never silently clamp or replace
quantization.calibration: no learned parameters in first screen; offline weight maxabs and runtime per-token activation maxabs; any future calibrated scale revision changes contract_id and requires new quality/hardware correspondence

arithmetic.product: signed integer weight code times signed integer activation code
arithmetic.overflow_rule: accumulate one K group into int32; group bounds above include 128 valid elements and are below int32 max; never combine different-scale groups as one integer sum
arithmetic.group_merge_order: for g=0..G-1 in increasing K order: term=f32(i32_partial_g); term=f32(term*w_scale[m,g]); term=f32(term*x_scale[n,g]); output=f32(output+term); no FMA
arithmetic.bias: none for scoped GGML MUL_MAT; do not insert bias
arithmetic.output_semantics: separate integer core exactness from F32 scale-and-merge tolerance; quality is judged end-to-end against original model, not against local floating-point error alone

layout.logical_weight: W[K,M], K contiguous within each output channel row; source strides must be checked against actual GGML tensor
layout.logical_activation: X[K,N], K contiguous within each token row; source strides must be checked against actual GGML tensor
layout.logical_output: Y[M,N] F32, M contiguous within each token row
layout.packed_weight_order: m-major, then g-major, then k-within-group; W4 low nibble for even local k and high nibble for odd local k
layout.scale_order: weight_scale[m,g] and activation_scale[n,g] are row-major F32 arrays
layout.tail: last K group uses valid_k=min(128,K-128*g); padded codes are zero and do not enter maxabs or partial sum; M/N tile tails write only valid elements
layout.staging_rule: bounded tile BOs; full W/X/Y tensors remain in ordinary DDR, not simultaneous contiguous CMA copies

change_control: A change to group size, scale rule, code range, packing, merge order, or output format requires a new contract_id and rerunning corresponding quality and hardware checks. W2 is intentionally outside this first frozen contract.
